articles.title: Pikachu Went to Space, and Now It Is Helping Celebrate World Space Week
articles.summary: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days on the space station, and ESA is using it to celebrate World Space Week with a Pokémon exhibit.

articles.title: Tennis Star Jannik Sinner Ends His Season Early to Rest His Knee
articles.summary: World number one Jannik Sinner is ending his 2026 tennis season early to get treatment for his right knee.

articles.title: Kitchen Singers Become Surprise Social Media Stars
articles.summary: The Tonics, a group of mostly dads and grandfathers who sing in their kitchens, now have nearly 100,000 Instagram followers.
